reference.source_art_policy: Full-resolution source anchors and isolated component studies remain production-source artifacts. The public playtest branch carries a self-contained art review plus the embedded runtime atlas.
reference.note: Only art regions from the generated reference board are authoritative. Dashboard scores/checkmarks/text were discarded and are not evidence. The street benchmark is never used as a baked gameplay background.

runtime.staging_subset_note: Public Phaser staging carries 4 selected variants per family; the full 34-item derivative set remains in the production package.

gate.reason: Representative street slice still requires live Phaser review, collision/interaction authoring, final occlusion/cutaway, production character presentation and mandatory integrated rubric threshold.
